exposure: low-dose intravenous magnesium sulfate (4g bolus + 0.8g/hour maintenance)
cohort: 60 eclamptic women attending the labor room.
finding: The low-dose magnesium sulfate regimen had a statistically significant lower incidence of side effects and complications, but a higher rate of treatment failure compared to the conventional Pritchard's regimen.
followup_time: 24 hours after delivery or last seizure
